description: This session, I was proud to submit testimony in support of H.3456, An Act relative to work and family mobility during and subsequent to the COVID-19 emergency. It’s long past time for Massachusetts to allow undocumented immigrants to drive with a license. It’s a commonsense measure that will improve traffic safety, reduce racial inequities, and …
title: My Testimony in Support of Driver's Licenses for All | Adrian Madaro | Adrian Madaro
